correctionNotes: AutoEq has no published exact match, so use the user-provided Simkin Boris measurement graph and conservative earbud tuning notes rather than exact Harman correction.
Do not chase sealed-IEM sub-bass; modest low-shelf support is acceptable but large boosts will likely add distortion or do little acoustically.
Preserve the audible midrange strength; smooth likely roughness around 4-5 kHz and add only gentle upper-air support.
Fit, foam cover, and shell position can change response strongly below about 500-1000 Hz.
signature: Open flat-head earbud with seal-dependent bass roll-off, clear and forward-feeling mids, a budget roughness/edge around the upper-mid to lower-treble region, and limited true sub-bass. Best treated as a mid-focused, lightweight earbud rather than forced into full Harman bass.
source: Official Moondrop product specs: https://moondroplab.com/en/products/nice-buds ; user-provided Simkin Boris frequency response screenshot at /Users/donahn/Downloads/Moondrop-Nice-Buds-PFR.jpg ; Simkin Boris review/measurements: https://simkinbh.com/?p=19103 . Caveat: no AutoEq exact match or raw target-compensated data; tuning is a conservative baseline inferred from the graph and user listening notes.
